name: Lightwell Demo — Block Known Critical CVEs
description: Blocks images containing specific high-profile CVEs: Log4Shell, Text4Shell, and SnakeYAML RCE. Part of the Lightwell + ACS + TPA demo.
rationale: These CVEs are well-known, widely exploited, and must be blocked at build and deploy time.
remediation: Replace affected dependencies with Lightwell Network remediated versions (e.g., log4j-core:2.14.1.rhlw-00001).
